per_case.bug_description: Merchant can see Super Admin dashboard link in navigation bar after login
No error message shown after account is locked following 3 failed login attempts
Customer can access merchant product management page by navigating directly to the URL
Role badge not displayed in navigation bar after login
Super Admin cannot see the View User Details button on user management page
Login API returns 200 with incorrect password instead of 401
Register API returns 500 when email already exists instead of 400
Refresh token endpoint returns 200 with expired token instead of 403
Logout endpoint returns 200 without a valid bearer token
Merchant dashboard does not show total products count
